svg.title: Bone Counters: Linocut
svg.desc: Bone Counters (1D): the sowing board cut as a linocut, bold black on cream with gouge marks in the pits. A hand drops one counter on the beat into the next hollow; the carved arrow shows the sowing running anticlockwise past the player's keep. One hollow is rung, ringed in red, and the row of heartbeat marks below shows which drop rang on time.
